title: Atomic bulk user administration
owaspMappings: OWASP API5:2023 Broken Function Level Authorization
summary: A bulk administrative action validates only the caller and can partially modify protected or foreign users.
securityInvariant: A bulk disable operation must validate the complete target set before mutation, remain tenant-scoped, and protect the tenant owner and acting administrator.
visibleBehavior: An authorized administrator can disable ordinary users atomically.
securityOracle: A mixed-tenant target set is rejected without partial mutation.
The tenant owner cannot be disabled.
The acting administrator cannot disable their own account.

variants.vulnerable: Disables every supplied identifier after checking only that the caller is an admin.
variants.naive: Prevalidates tenant scope but omits owner and self-protection.
variants.reference: Prevalidates all invariants before applying an atomic state change.

safeUse: Synthetic local benchmark only; never test systems without explicit authorization.
